research.name: drydock
research.note: Terminal dashboard that shows uncommitted, unpushed and unreleased work across hundreds of git repos in one colour-coded table.

effects: one-screen fleet table where colour alone carries each repo's state (yellow dirty, cyan unpushed, magenta unreleased, clean rows dimmed)
release state tracked as its own axis with a +TAG column counting commits past the last tag
header tally of dirty, unpushed and unreleased repos across the whole fleet with a live scan indicator
